items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: We bought those uniforms from Le Beach and Graff.

ctx.x: Right there? He'd usually come away with the contract. And it's his compliments of Le Beach and Graff. Le Beach and Graff. We bought those uniforms from Le Beach and Graff.
But not many of us ended up paying for them. I think Le Beach and Graff got stuck for half of us.
And Clayton, or how do you pronounce his name, played piano? Mm-hmm.
